agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 government Skill University listing explicitly contains Symbiosis University of Applied Sciences, Indore, Madhya Pradesh.

The official Programs page lists B.Tech in Cyber Security, but its linked official page returned HTTP 404; the current homepage and main navigation omit it. It is retained as verified_programme_family only, and catalogue completeness is partial, so manual_review is required.

The official site mentions short-term skill-based courses, but no standalone certificate programme was present in the current official programme catalogue; embedded industry certifications were not imported as separate university certificate programmes.
Eligibility was left null for M.Tech and MBA records where official course pages and the central eligibility page conflict on thresholds and selection requirements; no conflicting value was guessed.
Normal TLS first produced the exact self-signed proxy certificate-chain error. Public GETs then used curl --insecure only for the expected government, search, and official institutional hosts.
career_path.db was queried read-only. Nearest-parent and closest-specialization mappings are explicitly labeled where the local career tree lacks an exact discipline node.
